title: Needs attention
summary: The problems that need a person, in a card: a heading with a badge per severity, then each problem with a filled status icon, its title, what · how long · where, one quiet action and a «⋯» to snooze or dismiss it (undone from the notice), at most five and «Все проблемы (N)», when the checks ran and a recheck. With none, one quiet line «Всё в порядке · проверено …». group="severity" is the full checks page with a closed «Пройдено».

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

label.description: The heading; «Требует внимания» / «Needs attention» in the page language when not set. The summary badges, one per severity, stand beside it

heading-level.description: The level of the heading in the page's outline

frame.description: card (the default) draws the list as a surface card: a hairline edge, the surface radius, the head and the foot as bars of it; none is the bare list of 1.1, its rows on the page's text edge

triage.description: Each problem gets a «⋯» menu: «Отложить на день», «Отложить на неделю» and, where the person may, «Не напоминать». A choice asks snooze {id, until} or dismiss {id}, then sets the problem aside with a notice whose «Вернуть» sends undo. A problem with help has the menu without triage too (only «Подробнее о проверке»)

dismissible.description: This person may dismiss problems («Не напоминать», triage): the page's permission, and the only one that grants it; an item's dismissible: false takes it away from that item, its dismissible: true grants nothing

checked-at.description: When the checks last ran (an ISO date-time or milliseconds): the foot says «Проверено 5 мин назад» / «в 14:05» / «9 ноября в 14:05» with a recheck button that sends recheck; the empty line says «Всё в порядке · проверено …»

limit.description: At most this many rows; the rest are behind «Все проблемы (N)» (more-href) or «Показать все (N)» in place. 0 shows every row. Group mode shows every row

more-href.description: The page of every problem: the foot's «Все проблемы (N)» is a link there, its press the cancelable request all {href}

group.description: severity is the full checks page: a disclosure group per severity («Ошибки», «Предупреждения», «Рекомендации») open, «Пройдено» (passed) closed, an aligned column of affected counts; the time of the checks in the head

empty.description: With no items: line (the default, owner decision C37) draws the head and one quiet line, empty-text with a check, «· проверено …» after it with checked-at, and a recheck button; none draws nothing at all (the host takes no room)

empty-text.description: The quiet line of empty line; «Всё в порядке» / «All is well» when not set

size.description: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (change journal attribute-list-attention-size-to-density): the density comes from the page (data-sf-density, decision C22), never from a size. Until then size="1/2" still draws the list compact, noted in SF.deprecations and said once in the console (by SF.deprecations alone where the page opted in to its warnings); 1 is the normal density. Removing size="1": inside a compact region the list becomes compact; data-sf-density="normal" keeps it normal

items.description: The problems that need a person, each {id, status error|warning|info|success, title, text?, object?: {label, href?}, since?, source?, affected?, help?, dismissible?, action?: {label, href} or {label, event}}. object is what the problem is about (a link with href), since when it began (an ISO date-time or milliseconds; the row says how long it lasts), source the section or check it comes from, affected how many objects it touches (group mode's column), help a link about the check (the «⋯» menu), dismissible: false keeps «Не напоминать» off this item (the permission is the host's dismissible; an item can take it away, never give it). A property, or the JSON island a server prints; the host sets the whole list again when a problem appears or ends. The list orders them by severity (error, warning, info, success), inside a status the longest-lasting first where since is given, then the host's order. An item without an id or a title is left out; another status reads as info

passed.description: Group mode's «Пройдено»: the checks that passed, strings or {id?, title, text?}, a closed group after the problems

sf-list-attention-navigate.summary: A person pressed a link of an item: its action's (part action), its object's (part object) or «Подробнее о проверке» in its «⋯» (part help) (vocabulary §5 navigate {id, href}). A request: a page cancels it to go there itself (a router); not cancelled, the browser follows href. A press with a modifier key or a middle button opens the link elsewhere and asks nothing

sf-list-attention-apply.summary: A person pressed an item's action button, one without href (vocabulary §5 apply {action, scope: entry, ids}): action is the item's action.event, ids the item's id. The host does it (restarts a job, opens a dialog) and sets the list again

sf-list-attention-snooze.summary: A person chose «Отложить на день» or «на неделю» in an item's «⋯»: until is the ISO instant one or seven days on. A request: cancelled, nothing changes; not cancelled, the item is set aside here at once and a notice says so with «Вернуть». The host stores the snooze and leaves the item out of the list until then

sf-list-attention-dismiss.summary: A person chose «Не напоминать» (only where the host's dismissible allows it). A request: cancelled, nothing changes; not cancelled, the item is set aside with a notice and «Вернуть»; the host stores it

sf-list-attention-undo.summary: A person pressed «Вернуть» on the notice of a snooze or a dismiss (action snooze | dismiss): the item is back in the list; the host forgets what it stored

sf-list-attention-recheck.summary: A person pressed «Проверить снова» (shown with checked-at). The host runs the checks and sets items and checked-at again

sf-list-attention-all.summary: A person pressed «Все проблемы (N)»: with more-href a link, the request first (a router cancels it); without it «Показать все (N)», and not cancelled, every row is shown in place

forbidden_client_responsibilities: finding the problems (the host checks and sets the list)
deciding when a problem ends (the host sets the list again)
doing an action (the host answers apply or navigate)
storing a snooze or a dismiss (the host answers snooze, dismiss and undo)

keyboard: Tab reaches each item's object link, action and «⋯» in order, then the foot's recheck and «Все проблемы»; Enter follows a link, Enter or Space presses a button
In the «⋯» menu the arrows move, Enter chooses, Escape closes and gives the focus back
accessibility.focus: The list takes the focus only when the row that had it is set aside and no other row is left (tabindex -1 on the section).

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-list-attention on an overview screen for the problems that need a person now: server health, site checks, import errors, update readiness, a form's validation summary.
do_not: Do not wrap it in a card of your own: frame card is its own frame; frame none for a list inside a card
Do not use it for news or a history; sf-list-feed or a timeline does that
Do not use it for a page-wide condition above the header; sf-alert-bar does that
Do not store snoozes in the page: the host stores what snooze and dismiss ask and leaves those items out
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-list-attention triage checked-at="2026-11-09T14:05:00+03:00" more-href="/checks/"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "cert", "status": "warning", "title": "Сертификат истекает через 6 дней", "object": {"label": "demo-static.test", "href": "/sites/demo-static/"}, "source": "Сертификаты", "action": {"label": "Продлить", "href": "/sites/demo-static/ssl/"}}]}</script></sf-list-attention>
